instruction: Every on-screen, VO, and paid-copy claim must appear in the Claim & asset ledger with a provenance tag. Omitted claims are preferred over invented ones.

provenance_tags.ASSET_VERIFIED: Read from attached photo, site, or footage
provenance_tags.ASSUMED: Brief-default assumption — listed under Brief → Assumptions; not a proof claim

global_bans: Invented reviews, star ratings, customer counts, CTR/ROAS/CPA
Celebrity or influencer endorsement without user proof
Fake scarcity timers or prices not supplied by user
Photorealistic minors / children as AI talent
Synthetic person claiming personal use/results as a real customer

health.required_line_if_claims: Individual results vary. Not medical advice.
health.notes: Prefer symptom-scene empathy without disease claims; no Meta personal-attribute targeting copy.

beauty.notes: Before/after: matched lighting; avoid body-image zoom policies on Meta/TikTok.

fitness.notes: Weight-loss before/after often restricted — prefer process/form demos.

fintech.required_line_if_claims: Investing involves risk. Past performance ≠ future results.
fintech.notes: May need Special Ad Category / financial services authorization per platform.

real-estate.notes: Housing Special Ad Category on Meta when applicable.

kids-family.notes: Do not generate photorealistic children. Parent hands / product only unless real child + consent.

local-services.notes: Phone, license, geo must be USER_SUPPLIED or PLACEHOLDER.

saas.notes: UI must be real screenshots (ASSET_VERIFIED) — never invent dashboards.
